prompt: Among the female competitive swimmers who won the most Olympic gold medals in a single games from 1989 to 2019, who achieved this feat at a younger age?
answer: **Missy Franklin** achieved it at the younger age. She won **four gold medals at the 2012 London Olympics when she was 17**, younger than Amy Van Dyken (23 in 1996) and Katie Ledecky (19 in 2016), who also won four golds in a single Games during that period.
